capabilities: Open vault .html and .htm files as fully rendered pages
Toggle render mode between Electron webview and iframe
Reclaim .html and .htm file registration from other plugins
Reload, zoom and open pages in the default browser
Hand obsidian://, https and mailto links to the operating system
extras: Desktop only because it relies on Electron's <webview>. The README warns that rendered pages execute their own scripts, so users should only open HTML files they trust. Only one plugin can own the .html extension; a command and setting let this plugin take ownership back from another HTML plugin.
problem: Obsidian's HTML handling sanitizes pages by stripping scripts, so generated or interactive HTML files open blank or dead.
summary: HTML file viewer that opens vault .html and .htm files in a webview or iframe with scripts, styles and interactivity running.
